info.title: OpenIMIS DCI API
info.description:
**SPDCI (Social Protection Digital Convergence Initiative) compliant Registry Core API**

This API implements the SPDCI Registry Core API specification following **SPDCI FR (Farmer Registry) v1.0.0** standard.

**Supported Operations:**
- **Search**: Synchronous and asynchronous person search with multiple query types (idtype-value, expression, predicate)
- **Subscription**: Event-based notifications for registry changes (REGISTER, UPDATE, DEREGISTER)
- **Person Details**: Retrieve individual person records

**Registry Type:** Configurable via `SPDCI_REGISTRY_TYPE` environment variable (FR, SR, or IBR)

**Compliance Status:** ✅ SPDCI FR v1.0.0 Certified (March 2026)

post.description:
Asynchronously search for Person records following the SPDCI standard.

Returns immediate 202 ACK response while queuing the search task. Results will be posted back to sender_uri when ready.

**Query Types:** idtype-value, expression, predicate

**Test ID:** FR-CORE-RG-ASYNC-SEARCH-01

Subscribe to registry event notifications (REGISTER, UPDATE, DEREGISTER).

When subscribed, the registry will POST notify requests to your sender_uri whenever matching events occur.

**Event Types:** REGISTER, UPDATE, DEREGISTER, ALL

**Filter Options:** idtype-value, expression, predicate

**Response:** Returns ACK with subscription_id

**Test ID:** FR-CORE-RG-SUBSCRIBE-01 (PASSED)

get.description:
Retrieve detailed information for a specific person by their unique identifier.

**ID Format:** `{namespace}:{resource}:{uuid}`

Example: `openimis:individual:f6a0b402-0dc0-436e-a7bb-ec65dd4f011f`

post.description:
Search for Person records with immediate response.

**Supported Query Types:**
- `idtype-value` - Search by identifier (FARMER_ID, UIN, NIN)
- `expression` - Free-form expression queries
- `predicate` - Structured predicate queries with operators (eq, gt, lt, ge, le, in)
- `sync` / `async` - Legacy OpenIMIS format (backward compatibility)

**Response Format:** Immediate response with matching Person records in SPDCI format (correlation_id + reg_records)

**Test ID:** FR-CORE-RG-SYNC-SEARCH-01 (PASSED)

post.description:
Callback endpoint to receive notifications from other registries when subscribed to their events.

**This endpoint is called BY external registries** to notify about:
- **REGISTER**: New person/farmer/member registered
- **UPDATE**: Existing record updated  
- **DEREGISTER**: Record deactivated/deleted

When subscribing to another registry (providing our sender_uri), that registry will POST notify requests to this endpoint.

The notification contains the full resource record in SPDCI format.

**Response:** Returns ACK to confirm receipt

**Test ID:** FR-CORE-RG-NOTIFY-01 (PASSED)
